study_design.color_contract: Existing Rec.2100 HLG input/timeline/output, BT.2020 minimum 10-bit; no silent Rec.709 or extra tone mapping.
study_design.control: Creative motion/shakes off. Identical crop and timing for all variants.
study_design.duration: 5-8 seconds per matched segment, four takes; include head/hand motion and known problematic forehead/mouth regions after mapping programme time to source.
study_design.grading: Bounded secondary corrections; retain natural skin hue/texture and highlight/shadow detail. Background softness means calmer color/contrast, not inferred artificial blur permission.
study_design.reference: Exact source bytes retained; Apple decode and Resolve HLG decode comparison uses same source timestamps, crop, scaling and documented display transform.
study_design.review: Nitin selects final color only after comparisons. No full-song render, beat-effects progression, final-video approval, rights clearance, publication or deployment.
study_design.segmentation: Prove available API/GUI transport for tracked corrections before claiming automation. Reject temporal flicker, halos and skin leakage. No static ellipse mask, skin smoothing, face manipulation or generative alteration.
